meta.name: lsp
meta.description: Use when Codex needs language-server diagnostics, definitions, references, symbols, or rename safety checks in the current workspace.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在编辑器中获取代码诊断、定义跳转和引用查找
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在代码编辑器中快速定位定义、引用或检查重命名安全
copy.tagline_en: Get language diagnostics, definitions, references, and rename safety in your editor
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick access to definitions, references, and rename safety in your code editor

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 能通过 lsp 系列工具在当前工作区查代码:检查某个文件或目录的诊断报错、跳转到定义、查找符号引用、查看符号列表,以及在重命名前检查有效性、再执行重命名。
howto.when: 当当前工作区需要语言服务器的诊断、定义、引用等信息,或要做重命名安全检查时,Claude 会调用 lsp 工具接管。

say.text: 用 lsp.status 看看当前配置了哪些语言服务器
say.note: 会列出已配置、已安装、缺失、停用的服务器

say.text: 帮我检查 src/index.ts 的 LSP 诊断,只看 error
查找 getUser 这个符号在工作区里的所有引用
say.note: 在工作区范围内搜索该符号的用法

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can use the lsp tools on the current workspace: check a file or directory for diagnostics, jump to a definition, find symbol references, list symbols, and validate a rename before applying it.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the current workspace needs language-server diagnostics, definitions, references and similar data, or a rename safety check; Claude then calls the lsp tools.

say_en.text: Run lsp.status to see which language servers are configured
say_en.note: Lists configured, installed, missing and disabled servers

say_en.text: Check LSP diagnostics for src/index.ts, errors only
Find all references of the symbol getUser in the workspace
